independence_evidence: EE72 describes itself as a media and entertainment company co-founded by Edward and Akua Enninful, publishing 72 as its own quarterly; the website is operated by EE72 US Inc. and the shop by EE72 in London, with no larger media group involved (https://ee72.com/about, https://ee72.com/legal).
qualifies_reason: Independently owned quarterly launched in 2025 with its fifth print issue (Fall 2026) on sale from September 2026.
what_it_is: 72 is a quarterly print magazine of fashion, beauty and culture published by the London company EE72. Each issue is themed (the Fall 2026 issue revisits the 1990s, the Summer 2026 issue sport and performance) and leads with celebrity cover stories shot by established fashion photographers, backed by long interviews, essays and portfolios on music, film, art and Black British culture. It is aimed at readers of glossy fashion titles who want a large, collectible quarterly with multiple covers rather than a monthly.
